source: R64 fix (rule 6 volume-guards itself on fuzzy-search overflow, PR #308 Codex P1): prepared cache rebuilt against blocking.py post-fix, same v2 decision rules and the same shipped vector. Re-calibration was required (correct-no-match moved 0.0896 -> 0.0597, over the ~0.01 trigger): a bare cold start from equal weights regressed to TEST 0.7416 -- it only had to clear the naive equal-weights floor (0.6044), not the shipped vector, and would have shipped a worse matcher (nonzero false_reject on TEST) had it been kept, so it was reverted; a warm start from the shipped vector via --base (the documented procedure for this matcher version) reached TEST 0.9275, still short of the shipped vector's own 0.9333, so the write gate correctly left weights.json untouched. min_correct_no_match_rate loosened 0.05 -> 0.04: two no_candidates cases (no_candidates-001, no_candidates-012) that previously landed in the reject band on rule 6's now-suppressed arbitrary 200 fallbacks correctly abstain instead of asserting a refused search was a confirmed non-match, dropping correct no-match 6/67 (0.0896) -> 4/67 (0.0597); the other five bounds are unchanged -- their measurements are identical or moved less than 0.005
